definitions: Dismiss as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty.
Refuse to accept (a person or thing).
Refuse to consider or believe (an idea, proposal, or theory).
Show that one does not want to have (something); refuse to take.
Expel (a substance or object) from the body or a system.
examples: She rejected his offer of help.
The body may reject the transplanted organ.
He rejected the idea that money was the root of all evil.
The machine rejected the faulty coin.
